data_quality_notes: All country/territory records were transcribed from the full table supplied by the user.
USD fields are calculated by multiplying the source's thousand-USD figures by 1000.
Trade balance values are preserved as supplied; the dataset does not silently replace source values with recalculated values.
The World row is an aggregate and must not be treated as a country node.
Country-level totals do not reveal bilateral trading partners. Directed country-to-country trade edges require separate bilateral trade data.
The table includes economies and territories that are not sovereign states; labels are preserved as supplied.
The source text does not provide the complete bibliographic details for references [1] and [2].

schema.entity_id: stable normalized identifier derived from name
schema.relationships: No bilateral relationships inferred from aggregate totals.

relationship_model.reason: The supplied table contains national totals only, not partner-level flows. Creating bilateral edges from these totals would invent data.
